# Goal
Take the hopping efficiencies calculated in /home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure2_nested_transposon_hopping_efficiency/CM20260730_process_data_Omar_hopping_2reps.Rmd and correlate them with the chromatin context at the LP location.

Use the genomewide background chromatin data (processed in /home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_background/CM20260330_process_background_data.Rmd) to get relative chromatin context. 

# Setup
##Libraries
Load the libraries and set the parameters.
```{r load_libraries}

library(gtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)

library(ggh4x)

library(Biostrings)

library(GENOVA)
library(GGally)

library(ggbeeswarm)
library(scales)
library(RColorBrewer)

split_string <- function(vect,sep,N1,N2=N1){
  library(stringr)
  sapply(vect, function(X){
    paste(str_split(X,sep)[[1]][N1:N2],collapse = sep)
  },USE.NAMES = F)
}

source('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/01_genomewide_chromatin_background/CM20260330_compute_chromatin_background.R')
```

# Load data
```{r}
#load the background processed tibble
genomic_background_comb = readRDS('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260730_summary_stats_chrom_background.rds')

#load the encode blacklist regions
blacklist_bed = read_tsv('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/encode_mm10_blacklist.v2.bed', col_names = c("chr", "start", "end", "type"))

```


## process PB background data
```{r}
#location of the pipeline output files
path_context_500_PB = '/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/Omar_PB-500_summary.txt'
path_context_2000_PB = '/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/Omar_PB-2000_summary.txt'
path_context_5000_PB = '/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/Omar_PB-5000_summary.txt'
path_context_10000_PB = '/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/coverage_results/Omar_PB-10000_summary.txt'

#features we want to process
features_oi = c("'H3K9me3_pADam'",  "'LB1_pADam'" , #heterochromatin
                "'EZH2'", "'H3K27me3-2i'", #polycomb
                "'RAD21'" , "'CTCF'", #3D genome
                "'H3K27ac-2i'", "'p300-2i'", #euchromatin
                "'ATAC'", "'DNase'", #accessibility
                "'H3K36me3'", "'POLR2A'", "'TTseq_fw'", "'TTseq_rv'", #transcription
                "'MED1'", "'H3K4me1'", "'H3K4me3'", #CRE
                "'input_1'", "'input_2'" #input samples
                )

#load the tibbles
PB_tib_oi_500 = read_tsv(path_context_500_PB) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))
PB_tib_oi_2000 = read_tsv(path_context_2000_PB) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))
PB_tib_oi_5000 = read_tsv(path_context_5000_PB) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))
PB_tib_oi_10000 = read_tsv(path_context_10000_PB) %>%
  dplyr::select(any_of(c("#'chr'","'start'","'end'" , features_oi)))

#process the chromatin signal at the insertion sites
chrom_PB_500 = chrom_insert_sites(PB_tib_oi_500,
                                   filter(genomic_background_comb, window_size == '500'), #load properly
                                   blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")     
)
chrom_PB_2000 = chrom_insert_sites(PB_tib_oi_2000,
                                   filter(genomic_background_comb, window_size == '2000'), #load properly
                                   blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")     
)

chrom_PB_5000 = chrom_insert_sites(PB_tib_oi_5000,
                                   filter(genomic_background_comb, window_size == '5000'), #load properly
                                   blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")     
)
chrom_PB_10000 = chrom_insert_sites(PB_tib_oi_10000,
                                   filter(genomic_background_comb, window_size == '10000'), #load properly
                                   blacklist_bed,
                                       log_features = c("LB1_pADam", "H3K9me3_pADam"), 
                                       non_cistrome_features = c("TTseq_fw", "TTseq_rv"),
                                       input_cols = c("input_1", "input_2")     
)

chrom_PB_comb = bind_rows(chrom_PB_500, chrom_PB_2000, chrom_PB_5000, chrom_PB_10000) |>
  dplyr::rename(start_interval = start, end_interval = end)|>
   mutate(start = start_interval + as.numeric(window_size)/2) #actual LP location is 1/2 window size after start window

# saveRDS(chrom_PB_comb, "/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260331_chrom_context_PB_ints.rds")
```


# Load hopping efficiency
Add the hopping efficiency data from the three replicates
```{r}
SB_ints_per_PB_rep = readRDS("/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Figure2_nested_transposon_hopping_efficiency/CM20260330_SB_ints_per_PB_2reps.rds")

SB_ints_per_PB_comb = SB_ints_per_PB_rep %>%
  group_by(parental_clone, chr, start, end, nearest_parental_idx, LP_name) %>% 
  summarize(N_local_SB_ints = sum(N_local_SB_ints),
            # mean_dist = mean(mean_dist),
            # median_dist = mean(median_dist),
            # N_within_10kb = sum(N_within_10kb),
            rel_SB_ints_parental = mean(rel_SB_ints_parental))

PB_context_tib_filt_hopef = left_join(chrom_PB_comb, SB_ints_per_PB_comb) %>%
  filter(removal == "keep" & 
           !is.na(LP_name)) %>% #there is one old, wrong PB location in the chromatin data that is not in the hopping data, remove it here
  mutate(LP_nr = paste0(parental_clone, "_", nearest_parental_idx))


```

Do we remove PBs because of the encode blacklist?

```{r}
PB_bins_gr = chrom_PB_comb %>%

  dplyr::rename(start = start_interval, end = end_interval) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  GRanges()


findOverlaps(GRanges(blacklist_bed), GRanges(PB_bins_gr))

PB_bins_gr[5]
chrom_PB_comb %>% filter(chr == "chr12" & start_interval == 114942520) %>% 
  filter(feature %in% c("input_1", "input_2")) %>%
  mutate(remove_for_input = signal_log2 <cutoff_min | signal_log2 > cutoff_max)

GRanges(blacklist_bed)[646]

```
there is one PB removed that is on the blacklist, but this would already be removed based on our comparison to input (too low signal in input1 and input2)


## make heatmap
Get overlaps with bed file features (protein-coding genes)
```{r}

PB_gene_overlap = read_tsv('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/feature_results/overlap_Omar_PB_genes.txt',
                          col_names = c('chr_PB', 'start_PB', 'end_PB', 'LP_name', 'chr_gene', 'source', 'feature_type', 'start_gene', 'end_gene', 'X10', 'strand_gene','X12', 'gene_details', 'X14'))

PB_gene_overlap_protcoding = PB_gene_overlap %>%
  filter(grepl('gene_type=protein_coding', gene_details))

PB_gene_overlap_protcoding_forjoin = PB_gene_overlap_protcoding %>%
  dplyr::select(LP_name, chr_gene, start_gene, end_gene)

PB_context_feature_tib = PB_context_tib_filt_hopef %>%
  filter(window_size == 2000) %>%
  mutate(LP_name = paste0(parental_clone, "_", chr, "_", start)) %>%
  select(LP_nr, LP_name, chr, start_interval, end_interval, parental_clone) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(PB_gene_overlap_protcoding_forjoin) %>%
  mutate(genebody = !is.na(chr_gene))

PB_context_feature_df = PB_context_feature_tib %>%
  dplyr::select(LP_name,parental_clone, genebody) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "LP_name") %>%
  data.frame()
```


make wide matrix
```{r}
relevant_features = c(
  "H3K9me3_pADam", "LB1_pADam",
  "EZH2", "H3K27me3_2i",
  "CTCF", "RAD21",
  "H3K27ac_2i", "p300_2i",
  "DNase", "ATAC",
  "H3K36me3", "POLR2A", "TTseq_total",
  "MED1", "H3K4me1","H3K4me3")

PB_covs_2000_rel_maps_tibs = PB_context_tib_filt_hopef %>%
  filter(window_size == 2000) %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature %in% relevant_features) %>%
  dplyr::select(chr, start_interval, end_interval, start, LP_name, feature, zscore) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = zscore)

PB_covs_2000_rel_heatmap_matrix = PB_covs_2000_rel_maps_tibs %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c(chr, start_interval, end_interval, start)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "LP_name") %>%
  as.matrix()



```
actually make the heatmap
```{r 2D_heatmap_PB_LPs, fig.width  = 10}
#annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  parental_clone = setNames(
    brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[4:6],
    unique(PB_context_feature_df$parental_clone)
  ),
  genebody = setNames(
    brewer.pal(8, "Dark2")[1:2],
    unique(PB_context_feature_df$genebody)
  )
)

ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
  PB_covs_2000_rel_heatmap_matrix,
  scale = "none",                 # IMPORTANT: no additional scaling
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name="RdBu")))(100),
  breaks = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101),
  annotation_row = PB_context_feature_df,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = 'correlation',
  clustering_distance_cols = 'correlation'
  )

```


##heatmap with barplot
I want to add a barplot on the side of the heatmap, this cannot easily be done within pheatmap and converting to a real complex heatmap is a mess (because of the NA values).
Instead, I will extract the row ordering from the heatmap and make the barplot separately

```{r}
ph = ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
  PB_covs_2000_rel_heatmap_matrix,
  scale = "none",                 # IMPORTANT: no additional scaling
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 11, name="RdBu")))(100),
  breaks = seq(-4, 4, length.out = 101),
  annotation_row = PB_context_feature_df,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = 'correlation',
  clustering_distance_cols = 'correlation'
  )

ph = ComplexHeatmap::draw(ph)

order_of_clones = rownames(PB_covs_2000_rel_heatmap_matrix)[ComplexHeatmap::row_order(ph)]


```

```{r 2E_barplot_with_heatmap_PB_LPs, fig.width  = 4}
SB_ints_per_PB_comb %>% 
  filter(LP_name %in% order_of_clones) %>%
  mutate(LP_name_ordered = factor(LP_name, levels = rev(order_of_clones))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = LP_name_ordered, x = rel_SB_ints_parental)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_discrete()+
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,2), expand = c(0,0)) +
  theme_bw() 

```

## Summary correlations
Only for 2kb windows
```{r 2E_pearson_correlation_all_features_2kb, fig.width = 5}
PB_context_2000_tib_filt_hopef = PB_context_tib_filt_hopef %>%
  filter(window_size == 2000) %>%
  dplyr::filter(feature %in% relevant_features) 

cor_hop_eff_ls = lapply(relevant_features, function(fi){
  data_feature_oi = filter(PB_context_2000_tib_filt_hopef, feature == fi)
  test = cor.test(data_feature_oi$rel_SB_ints_parental,
                  data_feature_oi$zscore)
  tibble(factor = fi, cor = test$estimate, pval = test$p.value)
})
cor_hop_eff = bind_rows(cor_hop_eff_ls)

cor_hop_eff %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor, y = reorder(factor, -cor), fill = pval <= 0.01)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.75),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab('pearson correlation')+
  ylab('chromatin feature')
```

For all window sizes

```{r 2E_pearson_correlation_all_features_all_windowsizes, fig.width = 5}
# relevant_features2 = relevant_features[!relevant_features=="TTseq_total"]

cor_hop_eff_ls_ws = lapply(c(500,2000,5000,10000),function(ws){
  lapply(relevant_features, function(fi){
    
    data_feature_oi = filter(PB_context_tib_filt_hopef, feature == fi & 
                               window_size == ws)
    test = cor.test(data_feature_oi$rel_SB_ints_parental,
                    data_feature_oi$zscore)
    tibble(factor = fi, cor = test$estimate, pval = test$p.value, window_size = ws)
  } )
})

cor_hop_eff_ws = bind_rows(bind_rows(cor_hop_eff_ls_ws))

cor_hop_eff_ws %>%
  mutate(window_size = factor(window_size)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor, y = reorder(factor, -cor), fill = window_size)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.75),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab('pearson correlation')+
  ylab('chromatin feature')


```
Different window sizes are similar, except the 500bp (so 250bp either direct), that is too small to see the effects. Here of course the 10kb window includes the 2kb window as well. But it doesn't seem like the effect gets diluted / noise gets added, which suggests signals a bit further away from the LP might still influence the hopping.

show significance separately, so I can add it to the plots. 
```{r}
cor_hop_eff_ws %>%
  mutate(window_size = factor(window_size)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = cor, y = reorder(factor, -cor), col = window_size, fill = pval<=0.01)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge()) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.75, 0.75),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab('pearson correlation')+
  ylab('chromatin feature')


```
manually combine color for window size and significance in illustrator

## Correlation after subsetting
There are two extra correlations we want to show: TTseq and POLR2A after correcting for cCREs

```{r}
PB_DNase_nearest = read_tsv('/home/c.moene/projects/hopping_technology/SB_transposition_manuscript/Chromatin_context/CM20260310_local_context/feature_results/nearest_Omar_PB_DNase.txt',
                          col_names = c('chr_PB', 'start_PB', 'end_PB', 'LP_name', 'chr_peak', 'start_peak', 'end_peak',paste0("X", 8:10), 'score',paste0("X", 12:14), "distance"))

PB_DNase_nearest_forjoin = PB_DNase_nearest %>%
  dplyr::select(LP_name, chr_peak, distance) %>%
  dplyr::rename(distance_to_peak = distance) %>%

PB_context_feature_tib_DNase = PB_context_tib_filt_hopef %>%
  filter(window_size == 2000) %>%
  select(LP_nr, LP_name, chr, start_interval, end_interval, parental_clone) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(PB_DNase_nearest_forjoin) %>%
  mutate(DNase_peak = distance_to_peak < 2000) #NB this is a bigger window than the ChIP bw quantification
```
